capabilities: Apply built-in colour and glow presets to the graph view
Create custom presets with colours, background, glow and physics sliders
Share presets via one-line gs1/gs2 share codes
Export the graph or local graph as a PNG
Open an experimental 3D graph view with orbital and globe layouts
disambiguation: Styles only Obsidian's graph view; it does not render Mermaid diagrams or other chart types.
extras: Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.4.0+; MIT licensed; makes no network calls and never edits notes, only graph.json, CSS snippets and exported PNGs. The 3D graph is explicitly experimental (needs WebGL 2) and off by default. English and Korean UI; detailed FAQ, limits and troubleshooting in the README.
intentEvidence: Graph Styler restyles the Obsidian graph view in one click.
problem: Obsidian's graph view offers no built-in way to restyle it visually without hand-writing CSS snippets and editing graph settings.
summary: Graph view styling plugin that applies one-click colour and glow presets, saves custom presets as shareable codes, exports the graph as PNG, and adds an experimental 3D view.
